bug_semantics: CWE-59 link following in Git LFS working-tree population: git lfs checkout and git lfs pull (and, in 0.5.2–0.5.x, git lfs fetch/get when the fetched ref was HEAD) opened the destination path with Go os.Create, which dereferences a terminal symlink and truncates an existing hard-linked inode. A colliding symlink or hard link at an LFS-tracked path therefore caused LFS object bytes to be written to an attacker-chosen location the user can access, including outside the work tree. A later MkdirAll on the parent path also traversed intermediate directory symlinks, and a bare-repo path-join bug (empty LocalWorkingDir joined with strings.Join, producing /<repo-relative-path> then filepath.Rel) could write outside a bare repository. Git's smudge filter path was not the issue: it writes to stdout and Git creates the file.
flaw_origin: The first working-tree write of LFS object contents was added as a feature in e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 (2015-05-21) on commands/command_get.go: if the ref being fetched was the current ref, the command did os.Create(pointer.Name) then PointerSmudge into that handle, with no lstat, unlink, or O_EXCL. Parent 685e8771d3ab811a02a8c40216c7b5c34793c7dd only queued downloads. That os.Create write shipped in v0.5.2 as git lfs fetch, was moved into git lfs checkout/pull by PR #527 (PointerSmudgeToFile), and was later renamed GitFilter.SmudgeToFile (PR #2687); the link-following open was preserved until the v3.7.1 unlink+O_EXCL rewrite.

reasoning: The advisory is a confirmed CWE-59 write-through-link bug, not a false positive: CVE-2025-26625 remains published, GHSA is not withdrawn, and v3.7.1 documents the CVE. The vulnerable mechanism is opening an LFS worktree path with os.Create (follow/truncate) rather than unlink plus O_EXCL, plus later directory-symlink and bare-repo path bugs in the same commands. The smallest first-write of that open-and-smudge pattern is e445b45c1c9c6282614f201b62778e4c0688b5c8 on command_get.go; the immediate parent only downloads objects and contains no os.Create(pointer.Name). Checkout/pull PR #527 and PointerSmudgeToFile/SmudgeToFile are moves/refactors of the same write and are not BICs; choosing 001ddcd7 or 45f3ae68 would also fail tag membership because those commits are not in v0.5.2, the documented start of the affected range. BIC is in v0.5.2 and not v0.5.1. The v3.7.1 commit 8b4aede153ff6555a7ad96deb2d57c333fdb446d is the direct replacement of os.Create on SmudgeToFile (unlink + O_CREATE|O_EXCL), with companion Lstat, directory-component, and bare-repo commits completing CVE-2025-26625.
